full_weight_comparison.method: Every byte of every published tensor; same-dtype bit comparison or explicit finite F32-to-BF16 round-to-nearest-even. CPU only. Full checkpoint download separately verified against pinned LFS SHA256.

comparison.scope: Metadata and tensor types/shapes only. This does not isolate a cause of prior performance differences.

limitations: One prescribed formatter task and related supplied hashing parent; multiple candidate hashes do not establish independent task or lineage diversity.
Independent regression and feature scores remain evidence; intermediate action success alone is insufficient for supervising code edits.
